text:
```yaml
name: AI Moderator
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created, edited]

jobs:
  moderate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Moderate with AI
        uses: github/ai-moderator@v1
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          spam-label: spam
          ai-generated-label: ai-generated
          minimize-comments: true
```
